raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-398 refactor on 2026-01-16 made silver_transactions.txn_date derive from ingest_ts (which is the next day at 02:00) instead of txn_ts. All 4582 POSTED rows are therefore shifted by one day, and the gold daily tables inherit the wrong dates. Deriving txn_date from txn_ts corrects it, and the downstream gold steps rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
